title: Stabilizing On-Policy Targeted Guidance in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05266v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Naive on-policy RL is often bottlenecked by the capabilities of the base model --- insufficient coverage can result in an inability to learn from certain rewards. At the same time, rewards in modern post-training systems often come from rich textual sources, e.g. judge models with a rubric of criteria. Can we utilize such structures to provide a rich directional signal that enables improving on otherwise difficult to optimize rewards? In this work, we examine a framework we refer to as targeted guidance that learns from per-turn textual feedback via an on-policy self-distillation objective. Our focus is not only on directly improving hard-to-optimize behaviors, but on how to do so throughout the training process without degrading baseline RL performance. translated_title: 智能体强化学习中在策略定向引导的稳定化
translated_abstract: 朴素的在策略强化学习往往受限于基座模型的能力——覆盖不足可能导致模型无法从某些奖励中学习。与此同时，现代后训练系统中的奖励通常来自丰富的文本来源，例如带有评分标准的评判模型。我们能否利用这类结构来提供丰富的方向性信号，从而改进那些原本难以优化的奖励？在这项工作中，我们研究了一种称为“定向引导”的框架，它通过在策略自蒸馏目标从每轮的文本反馈中学习。我们的重点不仅是直接改进难以优化的行为，还包括如何在整个训练过程中实现这一目标而不降低基线强化学习的性能。在智能体多轮软件工程环境的多种设置中，我们通过将定向自蒸馏与按评分标准的强化学习奖励相结合取得了成功，并且……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了“定向引导”框架，通过在策略自蒸馏从每轮文本反馈中学习，并与按评分标准的强化学习奖励相结合，在不降低基线强化学习性能的前提下稳定地改进智能体环境中难以优化的行为。
en_tdlr: Proposes a "targeted guidance" framework that learns from per-turn textual feedback via on-policy self-distillation, and combines it with per-criteria RL rewards to stably improve hard-to-optimize behaviors in agentic environments without degrading baseline RL performance.
